business_summary: Zhejiang Jolly Pharmaceutical Co.,LTD engages in the research, production, and marketing of Chinese medicinal products in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers Wuling capsule to treat insomnia, amnesia, heart palpitations, lack of energy, lassitude in loin and legs, and giddy tinnitus, as well as deficiency of energy and weak pulse caused by the disharmony of heart and kidney, or neurasthenia. It also provides Lingze tablet, which is used to treat frequent urination, dysuria, weak steam of urine, endless urine, and soreness and weakness of waist and knees caused by benign prostatic hyperplasia, kidney deficiency, and blood stasis; and Bailing tablet that is used as the adjuvant therapy to treat cough, asthma, back pain, and chronic bronchitis, which are caused by the deficiency of lungs and kidney. In addition, the company offers Linglianhua particles for the treatment of symptoms, including sweating, insomnia, dysphoria, heart palpitations, dreaminess, giddy tinnitus, lassitude in loin and legs, dry stool, and abnormal furred tongue, as well as weak pulse caused by perimenopausal syndrome, or disharmony of heart and kidney. Further, it provides azithromycin, clindamycin phosphate, doxapram, pefloxacin mesylate, adenosine cyclophosphate, and sodium nitroprusside injections. Additionally, it offers materials, such as cephalosporin sinensis, fermented cordyceps, and Wuling powders. It invests and participates in the medical services of Deqing No.3 People's Hospital. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Jolly Pharmaceutical Health Products Co., LTD. and changed its name to Zhejiang Jolly Pharmaceutical Co.,LTD in 1998. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Huzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Zhejiang Jolly Pharmaceutical Co.,LTD는 중화인민공화국 및 국제적으로 한약의 연구, 생산 및 마케팅에 종사하고 있습니다. 우링캡슐은 불면증, 기억상실, 심계항진, 기력부족, 허리와 다리의 나른함, 어지러움증, 심장과 신장의 부조화로 인한 기력부족 및 맥박약화, 신경쇠약 등을 치료하는 데 사용된다. 또한 양성 전립선 비대증, 신장 결핍 및 혈액 정체로 인한 잦은 배뇨, 배뇨 장애, 약한 소변 증기, 끝없는 소변, 허리와 무릎의 통증 및 약화를 치료하는 데 사용되는 Lingze 정제를 제공합니다. 및 폐와 신장의 허약으로 인한 기침, 천식, 요통, 만성기관지염 등의 치료에 보조요법으로 사용되는 베일링정. 또한 이 회사는 발한, 불면증, 불쾌감, 심장 두근거림, 몽환, 아찔한 이명, 허리와 다리의 나른함, 건조한 대변, 비정상적인 털털한 혀 등의 증상 치료를 위해 Linglianhua 입자를 제공하고 있으며, 폐경기 증후군 또는 심장과 신장의 부조화로 인한 약한 맥박도 제공합니다. 또한, azi를 제공합니다.
